_description: Canonical single-source federal (national) tax & finance figures for PFL Academy. Every surface (live app, free PDFs, print pipeline) should READ from this file rather than holding its own hardcoded copy. Created Phase 2 of the figure-currency wiring work; STOP-flagged figures supplied Run 2b (2026-07-24).

_authoritative_sources.irs_rev_proc_2025_32: IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32 (Section 3.01 Tax Rate Tables; 3.14 Standard Deduction; 3(3) Additional Standard Deduction) via gate/fixtures/tax_brackets_2026.json
_authoritative_sources.irs_rev_proc_2025_19: IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-19 (2026 HSA / HDHP inflation-adjusted limits)
_authoritative_sources.obbba_2026: One Big Beautiful Bill Act — 2026 SALT deduction cap
_authoritative_sources.ssa_2026: Social Security Administration — 2026 OASDI contribution & benefit (wage) base
_authoritative_sources.federal_student_aid: Federal Student Aid — undergrad Direct loans first disbursed 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30 (the 2026-27 rate)

_todo_stop_flagged: eitc.max_credit_3_plus_children (8231) — carried from PFL-Chassis src/config/taxConstants.ts EITC_MAX at commit 3de03dc (tag deploy-2026-07-28). It is the ONLY figure in this file with a single source: it does NOT appear in TAX_CURRENCY_2026_HANDOFF.md or gate/fixtures/tax_brackets_2026.json, so it could not be cross-confirmed. Confirm against IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 §2.06 (EITC table) before relying on it, and add the remaining EITC parameters (0/1/2-child maxima, earned-income amounts, phaseout thresholds, investment-income limit), which no PFL source currently holds.

_reconciliation_2026_07_29._note: Phase 1 cross-check of PFL-Chassis src/config/taxConstants.ts (commit 3de03dc / tag deploy-2026-07-28) against TAX_CURRENCY_2026_HANDOFF.md and this file, value by value.
_reconciliation_2026_07_29.value_mismatches_found: NONE. Every figure present in both taxConstants.ts and this file / the handoff agrees exactly: single + MFJ brackets (all 7 bands each), standard deduction (single/MFJ/HoH), 401k 24500 / catch-up-50 8000 / IRA 7500 / IRA catch-up 1100, SS rate 6.2% / wage base 184500 / employee max 11439, Medicare 1.45%, additional Medicare 0.9% rate, combined FICA 7.65%, SALT cap 40400.
coverage_gaps_in_taxConstants_ts: additional_medicare_threshold is a SCALAR 200000 in taxConstants.ts (FICA.additionalMedicareThreshold) and calculateMedicareTax() applies it regardless of filing status — it therefore over-taxes MFJ (statutory threshold 250000) and under-taxes MFS (125000). This is a live-code defect, not a stale figure; the value 200000 itself is correct for single filers.
SALT_CAP is a scalar 40400 in taxConstants.ts with no MFS half-cap (20200).

taxConstants.ts holds no HoH brackets, no MFS column, no filing thresholds, no additional standard deduction (65+/blind), no HSA limits, no 401(k) ages-60-63 catch-up (11250), and no student loan rate — all of which exist here.
_reconciliation_2026_07_29.note_on_ss_wage_base: TAX_CURRENCY_2026_HANDOFF.md (2026-07-24) states there was no committed fixture for the 2026 SS wage base and flags it for Denis. That was resolved in Run 2b: 184500 (ssa_2026) is now recorded here and independently matches taxConstants.ts. The handoff's open item is closed; the handoff text itself is simply older than the resolution.

income_tax_brackets._note: Ceilings are the top of each rate band (taxable income). 37% applies above the 35% ceiling.
income_tax_brackets._source: irs_rev_proc_2025_32 §3.01 (confirmed against handoff; 12% single ceiling = 50400 and 22% = 105700 per IRS, not the 49840/106250 some secondary sources published)

payroll_taxes._source: fica_total_rate 7.65 from calculated_variables_spec (resolver/resolve.mjs:30, CALCULATED_VARIABLES_FOR_SEBASTIAN.md §Formulas); social_security_rate 6.2 from tax_currency_handoff; medicare_rate 1.45 = fica_total - social_security. social_security_wage_base 184500 from ssa_2026; social_security_employee_max 11439 = 6.2% × 184500. additional_medicare_rate 0.009 (0.9%) and thresholds are the statutory Additional Medicare Tax figures (IRC §3101(b)(2), not inflation-indexed).

retirement_contribution_limits._source: 401k/IRA from irs_rev_proc_2025_32 (§415/§219 2026 limits) via tax_brackets_2026.json retirement_2026; HSA from irs_rev_proc_2025_19.

student_loan_rates._source: federal_student_aid + tax_brackets_2026.json student_loan_undergrad_direct_rate_2026_27. This is the 2026-27 rate for undergrad Direct loans first disbursed 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30 (effective July 1 2026) — verified against TAX_CURRENCY_2026_HANDOFF.md; not a prior-year value.

eitc._source: SINGLE-SOURCE / UNCONFIRMED — see _todo_stop_flagged. Carried from PFL-Chassis src/config/taxConstants.ts `EITC_MAX` (commit 3de03dc, tag deploy-2026-07-28), which is consumed by Station2MaximizeTaxCredits.tsx. Not present in TAX_CURRENCY_2026_HANDOFF.md or tax_brackets_2026.json; not independently verified against IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32.

salt_deduction_cap._source: obbba_2026 (2026 SALT cap). Replaces the pre-2026 $10,000 TCJA cap. Live compute path (taxCalculations.ts calculateItemizedDeductions) must be updated 10000 -> 40400 (single/MFJ) — see live-calc SALT fix.
